notes.title: Update #8 released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Update #8 is here, adding 5 new nations to the game (France, Russia, Finland, The Zulu, The Aztecs), each with their own special unit! There are also a couple of fixes and improvements.

About the future of the game, I'm aiming to wrap it up into a 1.0 release, and take it out of Early Access sometime during 2020. I plan to add some missing features (e.g. achievements) and improve existing ones (e.g. AI). V1.0 doesn't mean the end of the game, just that it contains everything I wanted it to have.

Have a nice Winter Solstice!


Changes in Build 20191209 304e91:
- Added 5 new nations (France, Russia, Finland, The Zulu, The Aztecs)
- Cancel razing a city when another production is queued
- Tech tree now correctly shows nation specific units
- If a nation has a replacement for warrior (e.g. Hoplites for Greece), they start with that unit instead of warrior
- Other smaller features and fixes

notes.title: Update #7 (hotfix) released
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

As I wrote in the June progress report I was planning to release the next update in August or September, but since a bug was found which makes the game half-unplayable, I decided to release a hotfix.

The specific bug is that nuclear physics (and thus dependent technologies) can't be researched. Most of the game data was converted to a new format while I was adding modding support, and somehow nuclear physics became dependent on nuclear physics. No idea how it happened, but now it's fixed.

Other changes include the City list and Unit list browser and new keyboard shortcuts.

For the next update Steam Achievements are planned, and some other smaller improvements. Probably coming in September, but I'll see how the development is progressing.

Cheers, have fun playing!


Changes in Build 20190706 83a092:
- Bugfix: nuclear physics and dependent technologies can be researched again
- Added keyboard shortcuts for Diplomacy and Research menus (Ctrl-D, Ctrl-R)
- Added City list and Unit list browser to HQ menu (Ctrl-C, Ctrl-U)

notes.title: Update #6 released
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The waiting is over, the new update is here, thanks for your patience!

Implementing modding required a lot of changes under the hood, and it took a long time to get all parts of it working.

The Steam workshop is now also enabled for browsing and subscribing to mods.

A sidenote for modders, please take a look at the documentation, there are some changes regarding mod file naming, and a new section about uploading mods to the Steam Workshop.

As usual, please report bugs in the Steam Forums or on the support channel.

I can't wait to see what the community creates!

Have fun playing!


--


Changes in  Build 20190519 24a060:
- Added modding support!
- Fixed a bug where AIs would start as nations already taken by players
- Using two colors for nation borders etc.
- Fixed decreasing a city's population when it's conquered
- Remove flying units when a city is conquered
- Improved rendering
- Stronger highlight for hovered and focused GUI widgets
- Lots of changes and fixes under the hood

notes.title: Update #5 released

- Added a leveling system, units can now gain XP and rank up
- Android version released
- Changed Caravel and Steam boat to have ranged attack
- Improved error handling, instead of crashing an error message is displayed when an assertion fails

notes.title: Update #4 released
notes.notes:
Changes in Build 20181002 cffda6:
- Added new map types: Continents, Islands, Lakes
- Added new map configuration options: water level, climate
- Unit's now can not be upgraded without the required resources (e.g. warrior -> swordsman needs iron)
- Cities attack back at flying units
- Cities' health can't go below zero so that healing is not delayed
- The focus stays on nuclear units after dropping the bomb
- Improved tooltip messages
- Fixed setting LD_LIBRARY_PATH in linux builds which could prevent starting in some cases
- Other minor features and fixes
